mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.seller_id, s.username AS seller_name, s.shop_name, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.main_image, p.sales_count, p.status FROM products p LEFT JOIN sellers s ON p.seller_id = s.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
